title: Draw a secret title
text: Everyone gets a secret title and draws it on their phone.

title: Write fake placards
text: One artwork at a time, everyone else writes a fake museum placard for it.

title: Spot the real title
text: The real title hides among the fakes. Pick the one you think the artist was given.

title: Scoring
text: Points for picking the real title, for the artist when people find it, and for every visitor your fake fools.
